name: board_check
title: Check board move
description: Check the arguments for projects_write (method update_project_item) against the pecot rules before writing: the field and option are on the board, and Ready or Blocked matches the judgment of the prerequisites. Reads and writes nothing on GitHub; pass the results of the official reads in reads.

method.description: Same as the method of projects_write

owner.description: Owner of the project (same as projects_write)

project_number.description: Number of the project (same as projects_write)

issue_number.description: Number of the Issue on the card

item_owner.description: Owner of the repository of the Issue

item_repo.description: Name of the repository of the Issue

id.description: Numeric ID of the field (list_project_fields); the value is then an option ID

name.description: Name of the field; the value is then an option name or ID

anyOf.description: Option name, option id or text

value.description: Value to set; null clears the field

updated_field.description: Same as the updated_field of projects_write: give either id or name

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

reads.description: Results of the official GitHub MCP reads the check needs

project_fields.description: Result of projects_list with method list_project_fields

project_items.description: Results of projects_list with method list_project_items (every page, with the field IDs of pecot-status and Status in fields): the cards of the Issue and, for Ready or Blocked, its prerequisites

issues.description: Results of issue_read with method get (the structuredContent, { issue: ... }): for Ready or Blocked, the Issue and each prerequisite

blocked_by.description: Results of issue_dependency_read with method get_blocked_by: for Ready or Blocked, the Issue

issue.description: The Issue whose blocked-by was read (owner/repo/N)

result.description: Result of issue_dependency_read with method get_blocked_by

pull_requests.description: Results of pull_request_read with method get: each open pull request that closes a prerequisite (closed_by_pull_requests of issue_read), and those its base branch stacks on; they decide whether the Issue can stack

issue.description: Issue the problem belongs to: a batch key or owner/repo/N (omitted when the check covers one target)

field.description: Name of the argument that breaks the rule (title, body, issue_fields.<name>, blocked_by.<i>, ...)

code.description: Kind of the problem (missing-section, extra-heading, cycle, ...)

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it, with the expected value when there is one

candidates.description: Values that would be accepted (omitted when there is no fixed set)

problems.description: Rules the arguments break; when empty, the arguments can be passed to the write tool as they are

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
